sourceEvidence.title: Principal or Sr. Principal Mechanical Systems Engineer
sourceEvidence.quote:
This position tasking includes concept development, problem solving, structural analysis, technical planning, design development and integration & testing of undersea hardware. The applicant will translate customer requirements into systems solutions that acknowledge technical, schedule, and cost constraints.
The candidate must be able to collaborate in a team environment, prioritize and adjust tasks to accomplish the project result, prioritize multiple responsibilities and/or accomplishing them simultaneously, and comprehend and analyze complex problems and develop solutions. Excellent verbal and written communication skills are required.
This position can be filled at a Principal or Senior Principal level.
**Basic Qualifications Principal Mechanical Systems Engineer:**
* BS degree in Engineering (Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering or equivalent STEM) and a minimum of 5 years of experience or MS degree with 3 years of experience.
* Proficiency in using common engineering design, production, analysis, and office tools.
* Experience with Finite Element Analysis tools, bolted joint analysis, and structural hand calculations
* Ability to work on site at Annapolis, MD campus.
* US citizen with the ability to obtain a TS/SCI and pass a polygraph.

* BS degree in Engineering (Mechanical Engineering, Ocean Engineering or equivalent STEM) and a minimum of 8 years of experience or MS degree with 6 years of experience.
* Proficiency in using common engineering design, production, analysis, and office tools.
* Experience with Finite Element Analysis tools, bolted joint analysis, and structural hand calculations
* Ability to work on site at Annapolis, MD campus.
